llm_response.reason: The suspicious use of a URL shortener leading to a redirect through a government-associated domain to an obfuscated external domain (bskeklive.com), which failed WHOIS lookup and had no legitimate visible content, strongly suggests phishing or scam activity targeting credential theft or malware installation. These redirection chains are typical in technical support and credential harvesting scams. The absence of transparency and use of encoded URLs are red flags aligning with scam characteristics numbers 3, 7, 14, and 16.
